Trigger / Detection Logic: Receipts from Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Shopify Payments, PayPal, Stripe, TikTok Shop
Expected State (industry norm): Gross sales, fees, refunds, reserves reconciled to payouts
Query to Client: Please provide marketplace/payment-provider settlement reports for the full year (all channels and currencies).
Engineer Notes: Recognise gross sales with fees as expenses where seller is principal.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Platform clearing / reserve balances at YE
Expected State (industry norm): Funds held by platform shown as debtor
Query to Client: Please provide platform balances held at year end (Amazon reserve, PayPal, Stripe balances).
Please provide return/refund rates and refunds processed after year end relating to pre-YE sales.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Stock held at FBA / 3PL / in transit not included
Expected State (industry norm): All stock locations counted incl. goods in transit
Query to Client: Please provide stock reports for all locations (own warehouse, Amazon FBA, 3PL) and goods in transit at year end.
Evidence Required: FBA inventory report, 3PL report, shipping docs

Trigger / Detection Logic: Freight/duty expensed while stock at purchase price
Expected State (industry norm): Freight-in and duty included in stock cost
Query to Client: Please confirm whether freight, duty and import costs are included in stock valuation.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Sales via marketplace AND seller established outside UK OR goods imported ≤ £135
Query to Client: Please confirm where the business is established, where stock is held, and which sales the marketplace accounted for VAT on.
Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: VAT and overseas goods sold directly to customers in the UK; £135 consignment rule

Expected State (industry norm): OSS / IOSS / overseas VAT registrations considered
Query to Client: Sales to EU (and Northern Ireland) customers were identified. Please confirm OSS/IOSS or overseas registrations.
Please provide postponed VAT statements / C79s for imports.

Expected State (industry norm): Income agrees to platform-reported figures to HMRC
Query to Client: Platforms report seller income to HMRC. Please confirm the turnover figures reported by each platform match the accounts.
Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: Reporting Rules for Digital Platforms (from 1 Jan 2024)

Trigger / Detection Logic: Fees/advertising % of sales outside expected band
Query to Client: Selling fees/advertising costs as a % of sales changed significantly in [months]. Please explain.
Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: Reverse charge on overseas services (e.g. Amazon EU entities, ads)

Query to Client: Please confirm platform balances held in foreign currencies at year end.
